articles.title: NFL results: Chicago Bears, Buffalo Bills & Baltimore Ravens win on record-breaking Sunday - BBC
articles.description: After kicking off the NFL season with a Super Bowl rematch and a trip to Australia, week one continued with a record-breaking Sunday.
articles.content:
The Arizona Cardinals have been tipped by many to finish with the NFL's worst record, while the Los Angeles Chargers are seen as play-off contenders.
But the Chargers were humbled on their own turf … [+916 chars]
